title: Business News | OneQode Signs 14 MW AI Capacity Agreement with AdaniConneX, with a Path to 114 MW
description: Get latest articles and stories on Business at LatestLY. Singapore, October 28: OneQode, a global provider of performance digital infrastructure, today announced it has signed an agreement with AdaniConneX, one of India's fastest-growing data center providers, for 14 MW of data center capacity in Siruseri Sipcot, Chennai, India. This agreement marks OneQode's first major AI infrastructure deployment in the country.

title: ‘Emotional intimacy’ from AI chatbots would be banned under Australia’s digital duty of care laws
description: Labor government under pressure to create social media watchdog as new online safety standards bill passes lower house The federal government wants to ban AI chatbots which seek to create “emotional intimacy” after prime minister Anthony Albanese raised the alarm in a heartfelt speech about children treating these agents as their “best friend”. But Labor is coming under increasing pressure to empower the telecommunications ombudsman to become a watchdog for social media and AI to give Australians an external complaints mechanism and allow the “naming and shaming” of big tech.
